Named because he arrives with his own site, his own channel, a catalogue of six records and a band that plays under his name, which is the definition of fronted in _players_note. Facts on the page trace to his EPK (venues, festivals, the Wildflower and Ullrgrass finalist placings, the Alex Dezen quotes, Wheat Ridge as home), his about page (the influences and the playlist company), his tiny desk page (an NPR Tiny Desk Contest entry every year 2019 to 2026), his music page (the six releases and a holiday playlist) and his channel description (a Denver Public Library Volume Denver featured artist). His band is René Moffatt & The Moonshadows; an earlier band name on one 2024 upload, The Broken Fever, is not published here. The booking contact on his site is booking@renemoffatt.com; the phone on his EPK is not published. The accent in René is his spelling and stays; the id and every path are plain ASCII.
_status_note: A listing that owns a page, the Tony Medina shape. Three flagships already fill the home grid.
_style_note: Daniel's own phrase for him (2026-09-20). It renders as the eyebrow over his name and says the one thing that separates him from the covers acts at the same size.
_material_note: His own songs lead every set he publishes. Covers are real and on his channel (Willie Nelson, The Beatles, The Cars, a Crosby Stills and Nash song club entry), so the set can lean either way on request.
_bucket_note: cocktail and patio for the solo and the trio; specialty because a songwriter's set for a listening crowd (a house concert, a retreat evening) is a set piece guests watch; budget on the same reasoning as Tony Medina, solo voice and guitar being the smallest live booking on the roster. Not party: his set is his own songs and nothing on his site sells a dance floor.
_config_note: His EPK sells two shapes, Solo Performances and Full Band / Trio Performances, and Daniel added the duo 2026-09-20 ('there is a duo version'). The trio in his footage is voice and guitar with lead guitar and bass (the Molecule Effect clips name Joe Mazza and Steve Combs); the full band on the Roxy and UMS footage adds drums, a four piece. The duo's build is written as voice and guitar with lead guitar, the trio minus its bass, because that is the only reading of his own ladder that needs no new instrument; his site publishes no duo, so if the second musician is the bassist it is one word in the rung.
_genre_note: His EPK: Folk, Americana, Indie-folk, Folk-Rock, Singer-songwriter. The americana label was widened to 'Americana, folk and bluegrass' the day he joined so the filter says folk somewhere; no new genre id was minted.
_img_note: His own press photograph from the EPK gallery on his site (photographer Kenzie Veritt in the filename): on stage at the microphone with an acoustic guitar under warm light, cropped 16:9 with the focus a quarter of the way down so the hat, the face and the guitar body are all in frame. No duotone. Provenance in media-sources.json.

Daniel's rulings the same day: the Willie Nelson cover (Uvp9zMRJrhI) and all nine Underground Music Showcase 2026 clips publish; there is no memorial rule and no sponsorship or alcohol rule on this site, and the first pass was wrong to hold anything back under either. Left off as curation, never as a rule: the other Tiny Desk entries (older home recordings of songs the page already plays), the 90-second why-I-write-songs story (not a performance), and the 2024 clip under the earlier band name (naming two bands would confuse a buyer).
blurb: It's a special thing to hear a song from the person who wrote it, and that's what you get with René Moffatt. He sings his own songs with an acoustic guitar. His music is folk and Americana, and it fits right in on a playlist with Josh Ritter and The Avett Brothers. You can book him on his own, or he can bring his band, René Moffatt & The Moonshadows, if you'd like a bigger sound.
seo_title: René Moffatt: folk singer-songwriter for events in Denver
meta_description: René Moffatt plays original folk and Americana songs for private events in Denver and the Colorado mountains. You can book him solo with an acoustic guitar, as a duo or trio, or with his four-piece band. Tell us your date and we'll get back to you with availability and costs.
identity: René is based just outside Denver, and he's made six records, including King of the Mountain and Here and Now Is Home. He's also entered the NPR Tiny Desk Contest every year since 2019. He calls his music heady folk for the open-hearted, and if you like Jeff Tweedy, you'll probably love him.

On his own, he's a great fit for welcome drinks or a patio party, at a volume people can easily talk over. He also works well for a dinner party or a retreat evening where you want everyone listening to the songs. He's played venues around Denver where people come to listen, like Swallow Hill and the Black Rose Acoustic Society, along with stages at the Denver Botanic Gardens and the Clyfford Still Museum.

With his band, René Moffatt & The Moonshadows, he plays the same songs with lead guitar, bass and drums. You can watch the full band on a Denver club stage and at the Underground Music Showcase in the video clips below. They've played the Boulder Roots Music Fest as well.
He usually leads with his own songs. He also plays covers from Willie Nelson to The Beatles and The Cars, so just tell us the balance you'd like and he can plan the setlist around it.
